keyFeatures: Personal Life Documentation and Journaling System
targetUsers: busy professional with a large social network

userStories.title: Comprehensive Contact Relationship Management
userStories.description: As a busy professional with a large social network, I want to systematically track and manage detailed information about my personal relationships, So that I can maintain meaningful connections with family, friends, and colleagues by remembering important details and staying proactive in my communications.
acceptanceCriteria: I can create detailed contact profiles with personal information including names, genders, pronouns, job details, and contact information (phone, email, addresses)
I can establish and visualize bidirectional relationships between contacts with customizable relationship types (family, friends, colleagues, acquaintances)
I can log interaction history including phone calls, meetings, notes about conversations, and shared activities with timestamps
I can set up automated reminders for birthdays, anniversaries, and custom important dates with configurable notification preferences
I can organize contacts into custom groups based on interests, activities, or relationship types and assign roles within those groups
I can search across all contact information using full-text search to quickly find people or specific interaction details
I can import/export contact data using vCard format for data portability and backup purposes

userStories.title: Personal Life Documentation and Journaling System
userStories.description: As someone who values personal growth and memory preservation, I want to document my life experiences and track personal metrics in a structured way, So that I can reflect on my journey, maintain accountability for my goals, and preserve meaningful memories for future reference.
acceptanceCriteria: I can create multiple journals for different purposes (personal growth, travel, family memories) with customizable templates and organization
I can write detailed journal posts with rich text, attach photos, and tag relevant people from my contact database
I can track personal goals with streak counters and progress indicators, receiving motivation through achievement milestones
I can log daily mood and emotional state using customizable parameters and view trends over time through analytics dashboards
I can create 'Slices of Life' - curated collections of meaningful moments and experiences organized by themes or time periods
I can set up and track custom life metrics (exercise habits, reading goals, social interactions) with visual progress reports
I can generate comprehensive reports and timeline visualizations of my personal growth journey and life events
